messages:
Robin: Quick sync — we have a LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter + Azure Marketplace listing opportunity with the NVIDIA HW bundle partner. Need to map owners, timelines, and the joint announcement playbook. Can eng commit to a minimal adapter + smoke tests in ~3w? :calendar:
Mateo: 3 weeks is tight but doable for a v0 adapter (core read/write + batching). will need a clear API contract and sample dataset.
Jing: DevRel can produce a demo notebook + short video once the adapter supports streaming and embeddings. suggest a small end-to-end example (KB retrieval -> rerank -> summarization).
Sam: Marketplace/partner-eng FYI — Azure will require the publisher contract + security checklist signed before publish. also need a performance matrix (latency/throughput on the HW bundle).
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace manifest checklist: icon 512x512, listing description (<= 2000 chars), support contact, pricing SKU mapping, vendor ID. Deadlines: manifest + assets 10 business days before publish.
Robin: Action list (owners):
- Adapter spec & API contract: @Mateo (owner)
- Security checklist & contract: @Sam (owner)
- Demo notebook + announcement draft: @Jing (owner)
- Marketplace assets (icons/text): @Robin (coordinating)
Mateo: quick sample for how the adapter will be invoked (for demos):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/langchain/run \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"connector":"lindex-key-kb","prompt":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":150}'
```
Mateo: also pushing a minimal adapter config (YAML) to the repo today so Jing can start the notebook:
```yaml
adapter:
  name: redwood-lc-lindex
  batch_size: 8
  kv_cache: true
  quant_profile: q4_0
```
Jing: perfect — i'll mock the demo data if config is in repo. timeline proposal: adapter PR in 10 working days, QA + smoke tests 5 days, assets and marketplace manifest 5 days, announcement dry-run 2 days. total ~22 working days.
Sam: Confirming legal needs ~7 business days for contract review. I'll start the intake tomorrow. Also requesting perf runs on NVIDIA A10x2 — can infra run a 1000-request throughput test?
Robin: @Mateo can you confirm infra perf run request and estimate? if infra needs more time we may push publish date by a week.
Mateo: will submit perf job today. ETA 4 business days for baseline numbers. If quant_profile q4_0 holds, latency looks fine.
Jing: Marketing/DevRel ask — can we aim to announce the joint bundle and toolkit on Mon, 3 weeks from now? that matches our content calendar but flexible.
Sam: legal/marketplace gating points likely keep us to 4 weeks. prefer we set internal target = 3w and external announce = 4w to be safe.
Robin: OK plan: internal milestone (adapter + smoke + perf) in 3w; external publish + marketplace listing in 4w. I'll draft the announcement timeline and PR checklist.
Robin: last Qs: who can take the announcement copy once assets are ready? @Jing to draft, @Sam to review legal language, @Robin to approve final.
Jing: taking draft. will ping design for screenshots + demo GIFs.
Mateo: pushing adapter PR by EOD; tagging infra and QA.
Sam: started legal intake ticket: TKT-5428. linking policy doc: https://rwd.internal/partners/marketplace-policy (action: Sam to update when contract in).
Robin: awesome — thanks team. small ask: please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is green. we'll run a 15-min check-in every Tue until publish.
Mateo: :white_check_mark: (adapter PR queued)
Jing: :white_check_mark: (notebook scaffolded)
Sam: :eyes: (legal intake open)
MarketplaceBot: Note: next marketplace vetting window for Azure is 2026-04-02 UTC. schedule accordingly.
Robin: noted. saving this thread as the coordination canonical thread. will follow up with a short Loom for the announce flow. Thanks.
